verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at code.claude.com/llms.txt and raw Markdown versions of the Agent SDK docs pages (e.g. overview.md). Each Markdown page points agents to the full documentation index via llms.txt, and many cited SDK doc URLs are served as .md, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: an SDK-specific llms.txt (the index is shared Claude Code-wide), evidence of an llms-full.txt or bulk docs bundle, and first-party guidance on feeding these docs to agents.
